title: Role swap sends leaf rectangles to their coordinate swaps
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob), and let $p^{\mathrm{swap}}$ be the protocol over $Y \times X$ obtained by exchanging the roles of Alice and Bob throughout. If $R \subseteq X \times Y$ is one of the leaf rectangles of $p$, then its coordinate swap $\{(y,x) \mid (x,y) \in R\} \subseteq Y \times X$ is one of the leaf rectangles of $p^{\mathrm{swap}}$.
replaced:
If $R$ is a leaf rectangle of $p$, then $\texttt{swapInputSet}(R)$ is a leaf rectangle of
$p.\texttt{swap}$, the protocol with Alice and Bob's roles exchanged.
